candidates.decision_relevance: The analyses repeatedly use changing-membership top-100 breadth proxies, so endpoint counts cannot establish whether participation broadened or deteriorated persistently.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily analyses dated 2026-10-07 through 2026-10-10 report proxy breadth with changing membership and state that canonical breadth is unconfirmed; W37-W40 reviews also identify missing breadth history and methodology.
candidates.metric_name: Daily constituent-level breadth with point-in-time universe membership
candidates.missing_history_problem: A timestamped history of the same defined breadth universe and its constituent membership is missing. Aggregate snapshots with changing membership cannot distinguish persistent participation changes from composition effects.

candidates.decision_relevance: The analyses cite single-session or divergent settled ETF observations as counterevidence, but cannot assess whether flows persisted, reversed, or aligned in time with price and breadth changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily analyses report latest settled ETF rows for individual sessions and note that these do not establish a persistent flow trend; weekly reviews describe divergent flows without their aligned sequence or direction.
candidates.metric_name: Settled daily BTC and ETH ETF net flows by session
candidates.missing_history_problem: A timestamped, consistently defined daily history is not supplied alongside the reviewed observations. Isolated settled rows do not establish within-period flow persistence or timing relative to the other observed changes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Reviews repeatedly state that forecast precision, range containment, hindsight leakage, and matured outcomes cannot be assessed because candidate specifications and linked outcomes are absent.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews W33-W40 report omitted candidate definitions, issue times, bounds, and matured outcomes; daily analyses describe candidates as shadow research objects and note incomplete outcome scoring.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen forecast candidates linked to matured realized outcomes
candidates.missing_history_problem: A candidate-by-candidate historical record pairing the original issue-time specification and information cutoff with its corresponding matured observations and score is not available in the supplied analyses. Counts of candidates or matured outcomes alone cannot assess precision or sequence integrity.
